substantive_findings: 2019 1 July endorsement expressly replaces qard definition, tabarru 15.1, whole fund clause 16 and surplus clause 17. Surplus is distributed after qard, 50% operator / 50% eligible certificate holders; no-claim and year-end/distribution conditions remain. Annual share up to RM10 is bank-credited, or given to charity if bank particulars absent (1–4).

2018 1 July incorporation/notwithstanding provision adds death and TPD for six defined specified infectious diseases, RM100000/RM200000; doctor/diagnostic confirmation required. SID exclusions include first 30 days after last reinstatement, non-specified causes and pre-existing conditions (5–16).

SID002 TPD aggregate RM2 million; specific clause 1.3 expressly retains residual death cover when TPD amount is lower, with proportionate future reduction. This specific continuation qualifies general termination clauses within its scope; it is not an assertion all TPD leaves all cover active (9–10,15–16; base 33–34,60–61).

2018 interpretation, permissible interest/transfer, incontestability, law changes/assignment and first claim/setoff are present. Legal-proceedings wording literally bars action prior to expiration of two years, in both languages (8,14); not silently changed to an after-two-years limitation or treated as an external enforceability ruling.

Base accidental death and TPD RM100000/RM200000; public-conveyance accidental death is an additional equal amount. Accidental death/TPD windows are 180 days; disappearance 365 days with refund undertaking if found alive; accidental TPD requires attained age 6 inclusive (23,37–39,49,64–66).

NCD is 20%, noncumulative, with explicit first entitlement only at second certificate anniversary and claim/scheme reset. Snatch theft RM250/RM500 per certificate year. Specific NCD 1.2 qualifies the general following-year table/annual rule (23,40–41,49,67–68).

Optional rider combo requires inclusion in both master schedule and certificate: medical RM2000/RM4000, ambulance RM500/RM1000, corrective surgery RM1000/RM2000. Medical initial treatment 48 hours / later 180 days; surgery above neck, age 18 inclusive and 180 days. Reimbursement is excess over third-party payment, subject to stated evidence and annual limits (23,42–44,49,69–71).

Wakalah 55% years 1–2,40% thereafter; RM10 stamp is charged to you (master-contract holder), not operator-paid as in financing files. Free-look 15 days, grace 60 days, reinstatement within two years; later cancellation no contribution refund. Personal selection and contribution not established (24,28–34,50,54–61).

content_findings.finding: Unreplaced SMS003 15.3(d) ends the person-covered protection at the anniversary after age 70 in EN and after age 75 in BM. Both 15.2(e) separately use age 70 for the certificate owner. Ordinary 2.4x zoom confirms 70 versus 75; neither 2019 nor 2020 endorsement replaces clause 15. Do not conflate this with the separately amended TPD definition.

Base nonworking TPD age range is EN 18–70 versus BM 18–65. The July 2019 replacements agree on 18–70 but explicitly apply only to certificates issued from 1 July 2019. Zoom confirms digits and scope qualifier. Cleared for that later cohort, unresolved historical scope for earlier issuance; not a universal live difference.

EN renewal bonus starts in certificate year 2; BM prose says second anniversary, while both tables award 10% in year 2 and 20% in year 3 onward. Zoom confirms the timing mismatch, not resolved by a later endorsement.

Other-fracture exclusion uses EN kneecaps versus BM lutut (knee), while both separately cover knee dislocation. Ordinary zoom confirms different anatomical granularity; no claim outcome inferred. BM also omits the stand-alone funding sentence and renumbers subsequent clauses; general fund provisions still supply funding context.

EN surrender ends rights at the next contribution due date; BM 14.1 uses ulangtahun contribution-due wording. Zoom confirms anniversary wording. Preserve timing clarification, without assuming an actual annual delay.

Both NCD versions require one full claim-free year and refer to next anniversary, but specify first eligibility only from second anniversary. An additional initial delay may be intended; timing needs explanation rather than being declared a proven bilingual contradiction.
